# Colour grade look

**What overall colour mood does the footage have?** · [all approaches](index.md) · clashes: C32


## Warm golden
<a id="warm-golden"></a>

Warm, golden mids with soft highlights; for travel, warm temperature with the sun's disc kept.

**Looks like:** Skin glows, sunsets stay orange without clipping, and greens aren't neon. Inviting and nostalgic.

**Good at:** travel; warmth; flattering skin

**Weak at:** can look dated if overdone; not for cold, techy moods

**Best for:** formats reel30, reel60, carousel, yt-long · niches travel, all · goals shares, trust · effort low

**How:** Edits/CapCut temperature and saturation sliders; Khandala ffmpeg recipe (S-curve, R +0.03, saturation 1.10).

**Backed by:** [Warm golden mids, soft highlights](../topics/colour.md#colour-warm-golden-mids), [Golden-hour travel grade](../topics/colour.md#colour-golden-hour-grade), [Khandala grade recipe in ffmpeg](../topics/colour.md#colour-khandala-ffmpeg-grade), [Gym grade: cool, contrasty, textured](../topics/colour.md#colour-gym-grade), [High contrast, deep blacks, neon accents](../topics/colour.md#colour-neon-high-contrast) · sources L06, SP, KH

## Moody, desaturated
<a id="moody-desat"></a>

Highlights pulled down, blacks lifted, saturation −15%, soft vignette.

**Looks like:** A dim desk lit by a warm lamp, colours muted, soft shadows. Serious, filmic, late-night.

**Good at:** premium, cinematic; focus on the face and text; Lock In style montages

**Weak at:** can look flat or grey; less energetic

**Best for:** formats reel30, reel60, reel90, yt-short · niches tech, gym · goals trust, retention · effort low

**How:** ffmpeg curves, eq=saturation=0.85 and a vignette; or Edits/CapCut highlights −35, blacks +12, saturation −15.

**Backed by:** [Moody grade: highlights down, blacks up](../topics/colour.md#l10-moody-grade-recipe), [Before/after slider reveals the grade](../topics/effects.md#l10-grade-slider-reveal), [Gym grade: cool, contrasty, textured](../topics/colour.md#colour-gym-grade), [High contrast, deep blacks, neon accents](../topics/colour.md#colour-neon-high-contrast), [Khandala grade recipe in ffmpeg](../topics/colour.md#colour-khandala-ffmpeg-grade) · sources L10, research

## High contrast with neon accents
<a id="neon-high-contrast"></a>

Deep blacks, high contrast, saturated cyan, magenta and amber accents.

**Looks like:** RGB lights pop against black, the face is crisp, edges are punchy. It looks like a launch event.

**Good at:** energy; tech and gaming setups; thumb stop

**Weak at:** harsh on skin; needs controlled lighting

**Best for:** formats reel30, reel60, yt-short, yt-long · niches tech, gaming · goals reach, retention · effort medium

**How:** Contrast up and blacks down in CapCut/VN, with saturation boosted on accent hues only (HSL).

**Backed by:** [High contrast, deep blacks, neon accents](../topics/colour.md#colour-neon-high-contrast), [Graphic teaser grade, natural body grade](../topics/colour.md#colour-teaser-vs-body), [Extended bold sans titles, neon highlights](../topics/text.md#text-extended-sans-neon), [Moody grade: highlights down, blacks up](../topics/colour.md#l10-moody-grade-recipe), [Teaching text: clean sans, red/green](../topics/text.md#text-clean-sans-teaching) · sources L07, L08

## Cool, contrasty, textured
<a id="cool-contrasty-gym"></a>

Neutral to cool, higher contrast, clarity up for muscle definition, distracting signage desaturated.

**Looks like:** Muscles show texture under side light, the gym looks clean and steely, and bright signage fades into the background.

**Good at:** muscle definition; gym look; consistency per pillar

**Weak at:** can look clinical; skin may cool too far

**Best for:** formats reel30, reel60, yt-short · niches gym · goals retention, follows · effort low

**How:** A saved preset per pillar in CapCut, with a safe and a bold version and an orange-HSL skin check.

**Backed by:** [Gym grade: cool, contrasty, textured](../topics/colour.md#colour-gym-grade), [Grade spec: exact sliders, presets per pillar](../topics/colour.md#colour-slider-spec-safe-bold), [Graphic teaser grade, natural body grade](../topics/colour.md#colour-teaser-vs-body), [High contrast, deep blacks, neon accents](../topics/colour.md#colour-neon-high-contrast) · sources SP

## Dark matte with one accent colour
<a id="dark-matte-one-accent"></a>

Near-black background, warm key on the face, and one brand accent colour everywhere.

**Looks like:** A dark room, a warm-lit face, and every label, ring and banner in the same yellow (or red). It's recognisable at thumbnail size.

**Good at:** brand recognition; text readability; consistency

**Weak at:** one look everywhere; needs set control

**Best for:** formats reel30, reel60, reel90, yt-short · niches tech, all · goals follows, trust · effort medium

**How:** Light the face warm against a dark set; pick one hex accent for all graphics.

**Backed by:** [Dark matte background, warm key, gold rim](../topics/colour.md#colour-dark-matte-warm-key), [Near-black with one accent colour](../topics/colour.md#colour-near-black-one-accent), [Fixed set and colour identity](../topics/brand.md#brand-fixed-set-identity), [Teaching text: clean sans, red/green](../topics/text.md#text-clean-sans-teaching), [High contrast, deep blacks, neon accents](../topics/colour.md#colour-neon-high-contrast) · sources L01, L03, R1

## Mixing
L08 grades the teaser high-contrast and the body natural. Grades can be set per pillar (gym cool, travel warm) under one accent colour.

## Rule of thumb
Travel: warm golden. Desk and tech talk: moody or dark-matte. Setups and launches: neon contrast. Gym: cool contrasty.
